prompt: Karaoke-style lyrics for `media/song.mp3` (20s): each line highlights when sung, with click-to-seek on each line, behind a Start button. The entry file is `main.eligian` in the current directory; `media/song.mp3` is already there. The presentation starts on a timeline named `Start` that shows the button `#start`; clicking `#start` switches to the audio timeline, named `Song`, which plays `media/song.mp3`. The song has five lines, the elements `#line-1` to `#line-5` (write your own words), sung on `Song` at: `#line-1` from 1s to 4s, `#line-2` from 4s to 8s, `#line-3` from 8s to 12s, `#line-4` from 12s to 16s, `#line-5` from 16s to 19s. A line is highlighted by carrying the class `active`, only while it is sung. Clicking a line seeks `Song` to the start of that line (clicking `#line-3` seeks to 8s).
